column1: # Shared fixtures for the transitionKey encoding (cpp/.../JBAnimatedText/TransitionKey.h, Android TransitionKey.kt).
# Columns (tab-separated): the key as JSON, its canonical string.
# Two keys are the same when their canonical strings are equal. Rules:
#   null (inside an array; undefined too) -> null       booleans -> true / false
#   numbers: integral and |n| <= 2^53 -> decimal integer (-0 -> 0); otherwise 0x + the 16 hex digits of the IEEE-754 bits
#   strings -> "…" with \ and " escaped             arrays -> [a,b,…] (nested arrays too)
# A top-level null/undefined is not a key (no key: every change animates); it never reaches the encoder.
